entities.name: Query protein 409 aa
observations: 409-aa sequence is 62.7% identical to reviewed Bacillus thuringiensis flavohemoprotein Q6HLA6 across 98.8% of the query (E-value 1.72e-178); function assignment is homology-supported, not a direct experimental annotation of this query.
Closest reviewed homologs are annotated as nitric oxide dioxygenases involved in aerobic nitric oxide detoxification.
Reference flavohemoproteins bind one heme b and one FAD per subunit.

entities.name: Q6HLA6
observations: Reviewed Bacillus thuringiensis subsp. konkukian flavohemoprotein; EC 1.14.12.17; annotated nitric oxide dioxygenase activity.
Reference annotation reports one heme b and one FAD per subunit.

entities.name: NO dioxygenation to nitrate
observations: Reference reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADPH + 2 O2 → 2 nitrate + NADP+ + H+ (Rhea RHEA:19465); an NADH-dependent alternative is also listed (RHEA:19469).
